reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every single day. The lab testing is nice, but it doesn't change the format for me.
objection: Two capsules to swallow every day. I'd give up on it in a week and have 20 sachets left over.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink-powder version of the same tested magnesium at a similar price.
